turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Excuse me, does this bus go to campus?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: Yes, 이 버스가 캠퍼스까지 goes straight. It stops right by the main entrance.

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: How much is a single ticket?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: A single ride는 2달러예요. If you need a transfer, ask the driver and it is free.
